title: Consciousness units exist before space, time, matter and energy

statements.text: Each act of self-knowing of One brings a consciousness unit into actual existence, a part-whole of One with consciousness, identity and agency. The units exist before space, time, matter and energy and make up the quantum vacuum from which the universe emerged.

sources.quote: the CUs exist before space, time, matter, and energy

sources.locator: section 'The Properties of the Consciousness Units'
sources.quote: Each CU is a self, endowed with three fundamental properties: consciousness, identity, and agency.
